worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of arccosine is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arccos}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(15\operatorname{arccos}⁡x+8x) \\  & =15\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arccos}⁡x)+8 \\  & =15(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}})+8 \\  & =8-\frac{15}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.\end{aligned}
$$
